name: Test Case Generation & Verification Suite Design
purpose: Design, formalize, and generate comprehensive positive, negative, boundary, regression, and security test cases with 100% requirements traceability for QA Analysts.
whenToUse: Transforming Given-When-Then acceptance criteria into executable test cases
Designing adversarial test suites targeting security vulnerabilities, auth bypass, and injection
Constructing boundary value analysis and equivalence partition matrices for inputs
Building regression suites and assembling the Quality Contract for Gate G4 and G5
prerequisites: Architecture component interfaces or API definitions

inputs.name: requirementsContract
inputs.description: Approved Requirements Contract containing functional requirements and acceptance criteria

inputs.name: architectureContract
inputs.description: Architecture Contract defining component interfaces, data models, and dependencies

inputs.name: qualityProfile
inputs.description: Active quality standards, anti-slop rules, and testing coverage mandates

procedure.title: Acceptance Criteria Parsing & Extraction
procedure.action: Parse all acceptance criteria from the Requirements Contract to establish the verification baseline.

procedure.title: Positive & Happy-Path Test Case Generation
procedure.action: Generate deterministic positive test scenarios verifying expected behavior under normal, valid operating conditions.

procedure.title: Equivalence Partitioning & Boundary Value Analysis
procedure.action: Identify input domain partitions and generate test cases targeting exact boundary thresholds (min, max, min-1, max+1, null, empty).

procedure.title: Negative & Adversarial Scenario Formulation
procedure.action: Design negative test cases exercising invalid types, malformed payloads, rate limit exhaustion, and service outage simulations.

procedure.title: Security & Authorization Scenario Mapping
procedure.action: Formulate targeted security scenarios verifying authentication enforcement, role isolation, tenant segregation, and input sanitization.

procedure.title: Traceability Matrix & Verification Suite Synthesis
procedure.action: Compile test catalog into a structured test suite linking every requirement to concrete tests in contracts/quality/contract.json.

expectedOutputs: Comprehensive Test Case Catalog (Positive, Negative, Boundary, Security, Regression)

potentialFailures: Missing requirement coverage leaving critical acceptance criteria untested
Ambiguous test assertions that pass trivially without verifying payload state
Flaky test definitions reliant on unseeded random numbers or uncontrolled race conditions
failureAndRecovery.recoveryStrategy: Run automated RTM coverage audit to flag untested requirement IDs. Require exact assert invariants rather than status-code only checks. Enforce deterministic test fixtures and mock external clock dependencies.

verificationCriteria: 100% of functional requirements link to at least one positive and one negative test case
Every test case declares unambiguous Preconditions, Inputs, Execution Steps, and Expected Assertions
Security test cases cover OWASP injection, broken access control, and data leakage risks
